_comment: Copy to config/dev.local.json and fill secrets. dev.local.json is gitignored. Define one entry in files[] per FileMaker catalog you want synced. OData /fmi/odata/v4/{db} is case-sensitive; use the exact name from GET /fmi/odata/v4 on the host. files[].tables is optional: omit it to auto-discover only base tables from FileMaker_BaseTables on both sides. If you do provide tables, that explicit list wins. Per table, fieldOverrides lists extra fields to sync (e.g. calculated); ignoreFields excludes local auto-enter/generated fields.
